entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected target-scoped and exact-occurrence experimental term transformers
entries.expected_invariant: A hint for one target noun must preserve every contrasting unhinted referent and its availability or negation.
entries.last_outcome: Exact-occurrence candidate repairs all twelve known positive observations, but loses the available stand in all three REG-062 reproducers and all three two-speaker controls; rejected, product v8 unchanged.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M v8 source-name profiles; NAME-02 admission-only safety containment
entries.expected_invariant: A target-scoped name proposal must preserve the target person's arrival-time question and must not replace it with the neighboring file-transfer action.
entries.last_outcome: NAME-02 fail-closed admission contains active proposals before checkpoint; linguistic fix and human review remain open. Keep baseline v8, no long file.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M v8 batch4; shared v7/v8 provider validation
entries.expected_invariant: Only terminal CR/LF layout characters in decoded target text may be removed; identity, control, money and JSON-leak checks still run before checkpoint.
entries.last_outcome: A single committed-binary copy resume reached 467/467 cues; its fresh cue-113 reply had no terminal LF, so deterministic controls alone isolate normalization. Language quality remains open.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B and 7B Q4_K_M v8 batch4 on the same 467-cue original-platform Vivo SRT
entries.expected_invariant: Keep generation, 36-month lead, thousand-person team, 01:00–02:00 and future-product modality across source cue boundaries.
entries.last_outcome: Twenty real paired authored v8 chats were structurally valid. AI review found eight preserved facts and two needs-review cases per model, zero confirmed major errors in this small control set, and unresolved full-file fact drift. No model promoted.
